processt.text: A clear process from the start

evidence.quote: Our process has four stages: Discover, Design, Develop and Deliver. Discover clarifies the brief, Design tests spatial ideas, Develop resolves materials and details, and Deliver supports the agreed handover. No project duration or fee is specified.
